title: TREND: 1 of 12 as shipped, 7 of 12 under the candidate, same 12 rows
upstream_status_verbatim: TREND stays on the least-squares pipeline and publishes different bits.
status_plain: TREND has twelve counted live witnesses and TWO figures on them, which must be published together or neither is honest. The shipping OxFunc kernel - trend_kernel calling solve_least_squares with uncentered normal equations and a Gauss-Jordan inverse - scores 1 of 12, and additionally returns three spurious #NUM! results on the offset data because its EPS = 1e-12 guard trips on a near-singular X-transpose-X. The centered candidate kernel (the promoted FORECAST kernel generalised to the design matrix) scores 7 of 12 under every publication variant. The five remaining misses are the reason the row stays open: on two of four datasets TREND's effective slope sits a few ULP below the centered-covariance slope, and every natural centered variant raced reproduces FORECAST's slope bit-for-bit and never TREND's. Separately the catalogue records a CONDITIONAL result: given the coefficients, the prediction path TREND(x*) = a + b*x* reproduces Excel at 0 ULP. That is a decomposition, not a pass rate, and it must never be rendered as "TREND matches Excel".

ruled_out: x87 extended precision throughout — strictly worse, 4-5 of 12.
Uncentered normal equations (the current shipping kernel) — 1 of 12 plus three spurious #NUM!.
Any one-pass computational sum-of-squares formula — explodes to 4e18 ULP on the huge-offset dataset where Excel is bit-exact, so Excel definitively centers.

Every natural centered variant raced (forward/reverse accumulation order, x87-extended-throughout, centered QR by Householder, centered normal equations, FMA-accumulated dot products, symmetric versus asymmetric mean-centering, one- versus two-pass) reproduces FORECAST's slope bit-for-bit and never TREND's.
open_question: The exact op-graph producing TREND's centered slope on the two residual datasets is under-determined by only 4 datasets and 12 single-predictor witnesses, and the multivariate regime is entirely unprobed.
reader_warning: The 7/12 is a candidate score, not the shipping surface. The shipping surface is 1/12. And the catalogue's "the PREDICTION path is bit-exact" is conditional on being handed the coefficients; it is not a statement that TREND matches Excel.
